blocks.text: For applicants
Bishkek State University (BSU) has ten faculties, an institute of continuous and distance education and a college.

For the effective implementation of educational programs, the university has lecture halls, a concert hall, a cinema hall, meeting rooms, a training hall, laboratories, 15 computer classes, six international centers, 13 cultural and educational centers, museums, sports grounds and facilities, health centers, and a library.

BSU has a large sector of international relations, which gives students the opportunity to participate in an exchange program and study, do practical training or internships in 70 universities in Europe and Asia. The university offers the opportunity to study 16 world languages.
Уважаемый абитуриент!
